summary: Frontend-only testing of Fleet Management Dashboard with 7 horizontal tabs. All features working correctly. Sidebar simplified to only show Dashboard module. All 7 tabs (Vue generale, Performance, Efficacite, Conducteurs, Vehicules, Couts, IoT) are visible and functional with tab switching without page reload.

issues: Console warnings about chart dimensions (-1 width/height) from Recharts library - cosmetic issue, charts still render correctly

passed_tests: Sidebar only shows 'Dashboard' module - old items (Documents, Livre de bord, Alertes, Parametres) removed
All 7 horizontal tabs visible: Vue generale, Performance, Efficacite, Conducteurs, Vehicules, Couts, IoT
Tab switching works without page reload
Vue generale tab: KPI cards (Score Flotte, Vehicules connectes, Distance, Alertes, Temps moteur, Vehicules actifs) and Insights section visible
Performance tab: Radar chart (Performance Globale), Weekly evolution chart (Evolution Hebdomadaire), Top 10 vehicles section visible
Efficacite tab: Timeline d'activite with 12 expandable vehicle rows, clicking expands to show detailed metrics
Conducteurs tab: 6 driver KPIs with info buttons, 6 driver cards with score badges, detail drawer opens on click
Vehicules tab: Clickable KPI filters (Actifs, Hors ligne, Sous-utilises) with 'Cliquer pour filtrer' text, vehicle table with sortable columns
Couts tab: 6 financial KPIs (Carburant, Perte ralenti, Surconsommation, Maintenance, Mensuel, Annuel), cost breakdown donut chart, savings section (Economies Possibles)
IoT tab: Flow editor with 6 draggable node types, canvas with default nodes (Default Input/Output), save functionality
critical_code_review_comments: React hooks exhaustive-deps warnings in DashboardLayout.jsx, CostsTab.jsx, DriversTab.jsx, OverviewTab.jsx - should wrap variables in useMemo to prevent unnecessary re-renders
Recharts ResponsiveContainer showing dimension warnings - may need minWidth/minHeight props for edge cases
seed_data_creation: None - using live Navixy API data
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 dashboard tabs are working correctly. Navixy API takes 15-30 seconds to load data - wait for loading indicator to disappear. Data-testid attributes are properly set for all tabs and major components. The sidebar has been simplified to only show Dashboard module.
